title: Add two ETH confirmed-average LossDiff-gated child strategies
author: agent:/root

originalRequests.text: Теперь построй этот график таким образом - после каждой победы пусть он обнуляется начинает считаться заново

Сделай новый график LossDiff для той же стратегии, но без отрицательных значений. То есть когда количество побед превисило количество поражений, мы остаёмся на 0. Потом при первом поражении делаем +1 и т.д.

Ты меня не понял. Мы уже посчитали семь стратегий чуть раньше, но, как ты написал: "В моём моделировании `LossDiff 4` срабатывал только при точном значении:  "

Теперь нужно пересчитать те же стратегии, с полным обнулением при победе, но `LossDiff `N должен срабатывать при N, N+1 и тд.

Сделай две стратегии:

1. ETH 5m 1 Diff Confirmed Average Premarket LossDiff 4+

С той же логикой (подсчёт LossDiff c обрыванием после успеха), что и LossDiff 4+ выше

2. ETH 5m 1 Diff Confirmed Average Premarket LossDiff 13+ Positive

С той же логикой (подсчёт LossDiff без обрывания после успеха, но без ухода в минус), что и LossDiff 13+ Positive выше

scope.goal: Add exactly two enabled ETH 5m Paper strategies that begin with persistent LossDiff zero, follow only actual same-market entries of the exact confirmed-average parent, copy the parent's frozen entry intent, and gate those copied entries at reset LossDiff 4+ or nonnegative Positive LossDiff 13+.
inScope: Exact parent strategy ID b7c50005-0000-4000-8204-000000000001, code eth_up_down_5m_1_diff_confirmed_average_premarket, and only its actual entered and settled runs after the new state cutoff.

Exactly two new catalog variants: display names `ETH 5m 1 Diff Confirmed Average Premarket LossDiff 4+` and `ETH 5m 1 Diff Confirmed Average Premarket LossDiff 13+ Positive`, with stable unique IDs/codes and ETH 5m premarket scheduling compatible with the parent.
One-time zero initialization when the new migration creates each strategy's durable LossDiff state; ordinary service restarts preserve state and never replay or restore older parent history.

Durable, idempotent parent-run outcome accounting, exact parent-entry coupling, copied pre-submit entry intent, Paper execution/accounting, default enabled/unpaused/live_stakes=false catalog state, audit diagnostics, focused tests, migration tests, parity documentation, README, active context, and daily history.
A new ordered PostgreSQL migration after the immutable 0001 legacy baseline for the two catalog rows and only the minimal durable LossDiff state/event schema required by these strategies.
outOfScope: Generating, importing, replaying, or backfilling historical child runs, orders, fills, PnL, or LossDiff state; the user explicitly reserved history generation for a later request.

Resetting either LossDiff state on an ordinary service restart, deriving either state from the child's own wins/losses, or reusing the existing stake-sizing paper_lost_counter/live_lost_counter semantics.

Any third LossDiff threshold, Progress multiplier, altered parent signal, independently recomputed child signal, changed parent strategy behavior/settings, or changed stake-sizing coefficient behavior.

Enabling live_stakes, placing or cancelling a real order, deploying/publishing/restarting a service, applying the migration to Local or Production, mutating any database, or changing external venue state.
A Dashboard/UI feature for manually editing or charting LossDiff, a general LossDiff strategy framework, or unrelated schema, retention, strategy, accounting, performance, and cleanup work.
scope.periodOrFilter: Runtime accounting begins at each new zero-state row's migration-created UTC cutoff and includes only exact parent trades entered at or after that cutoff whose outcomes were settled before the candidate parent entry; no pre-cutoff history is included. Tests use fixed UTC times.
scope.firstVerification: Before product edits, re-resolve the exact parent ID/code/behavior and current dispatch/settlement paths, prove the two proposed IDs/codes are absent from source and the exact local catalog, confirm the immutable 0001 baseline checksum is unchanged, and preview the local parent row/run counts in a forced READ ONLY transaction.

requirements.text: Register exactly the two requested ETH LossDiff children as enabled, unpaused Paper strategies with live_stakes=false and an explicit fixed parent relationship.
acceptanceCriteria: The catalog contains exactly one `ETH 5m 1 Diff Confirmed Average Premarket LossDiff 4+` variant and exactly one `ETH 5m 1 Diff Confirmed Average Premarket LossDiff 13+ Positive` variant, both bound to parent b7c50005-0000-4000-8204-000000000001 and no other parent.

Stable identities are b7c50005-0000-4000-8225-000000000004 / eth_up_down_5m_1_diff_confirmed_average_premarket_lossdiff_4_plus and b7c50005-0000-4000-8225-000000000013 / eth_up_down_5m_1_diff_confirmed_average_premarket_lossdiff_13_plus_positive; focused collision checks find no duplicate ID, code, or name.
Both rows are seeded enabled=true, paused=false, live_stakes=false, with no operation in this task enabling Live or changing the exact parent row.
Both variants use the parent's ETH 5m premarket timing and enter only through the exact parent-coupled flow; no additional LossDiff variant is created.

verification.expected: Focused catalog tests prove exactly two collision-free variants with the exact names, IDs, codes, parent, timing, enabled Paper defaults, and Live disabled.

requirements.text: Implement LossDiff 4+ from exact parent outcomes as consecutive losses with a complete reset to zero after a parent win, and gate only subsequent actual parent entries while the pre-entry value is at least four.
requirements.sourceQuote: с полным обнулением при победе, но `LossDiff `N должен срабатывать при N, N+1 и тд.
acceptanceCriteria: The durable value starts at 0; each qualifying settled parent loss adds 1 and each qualifying settled parent win sets the value to exactly 0, regardless of its prior value.

The gate evaluates the value before the current parent entry. From zero, four settled consecutive parent losses produce values 1,2,3,4 and do not retroactively enter those losing trades; the next actual parent entry is copied because 4 >= 4.
At values 4,5,6 and above every subsequent actual parent entry is eligible; after a qualifying parent win settles, the next parent entry is ineligible until four new consecutive losses have settled.
Only outcomes of the exact parent count. Child skips, entries, wins, losses, restarts, and existing paper_lost_counter values do not increment, decrement, or reset this LossDiff.
Duplicate settlement observation, retry, process interruption, and concurrent reconciliation cannot apply one parent run more than once or lose an eligible post-cutoff parent outcome.

verification.expected: Fixed-time unit and PostgreSQL integration cases pass for zero start, 1/2/3/4 progression, 4+ continuation, win reset, parent-only outcomes, causal cutoff, retry, restart, and duplicate/concurrent observation.

requirements.text: Implement LossDiff 13+ Positive from exact parent outcomes as loss plus one and win minus one with a hard zero floor, and gate only subsequent actual parent entries while the pre-entry value is at least thirteen.
requirements.sourceQuote: подсчёт LossDiff без обрывания после успеха, но без ухода в минус
acceptanceCriteria: The durable value starts at 0; each qualifying settled parent loss adds 1 and each qualifying settled parent win changes value x to max(0, x-1), never to a negative number and never to a complete reset unless x was 0 or 1.

The gate evaluates the value before the current parent entry. Once qualifying settled parent outcomes produce value 13, the next actual parent entry is copied; values 13,14,15 and above remain eligible.
A win at 13 produces 12 after settlement and makes the next parent entry ineligible; a win at 0 leaves 0; child outcomes and existing paper_lost_counter values never affect the Positive value.
Duplicate settlement observation, retry, process interruption, and concurrent reconciliation cannot apply one parent run more than once or lose an eligible post-cutoff parent outcome.

verification.expected: Fixed-time unit and PostgreSQL integration cases pass for zero floor, loss increment, one-step win decrement, 13+ gate, 13-to-12 exit, parent-only outcomes, causal cutoff, retry, restart, and duplicate/concurrent observation.

requirements.text: Make each child enter only after the exact parent actually enters the same market, and copy the parent's direction, price constraints, and amount without independently re-evaluating the confirmed-average signal.
requirements.sourceQuote: Да, в этом и есть её смысл.
acceptanceCriteria: A missing, skipped, rejected, unfilled/not-accepted, or otherwise non-entered parent run produces no child order even when the LossDiff threshold is met.

For an eligible same-market parent entry, the child freezes one auditable ExecutionIntent whose selected asset/outcome, BUY side, target amount/stake, price limit or worst-price cap, order type, time-in-force, and other pre-submit constraints equal the parent's frozen intent; no newer market read may change those copied fields.

The child has its own strategy/run/order/fill/accounting identity and consumes the same frozen intent through the ordinary Paper or Live submission path; parent fill outcome data cannot alter the already frozen child intent.
Parent run/intent ID, pre-entry LossDiff value, mode, threshold, state cutoff, and gate result are persisted in child decision/skip diagnostics so the coupling and counter decision are auditable.

Default live_stakes remains false. Tests nevertheless prove that enabling Live in a separately controlled future operation would submit the unchanged copied intent through the existing supported Live path rather than use Paper-only execution semantics.

verification.expected: Tests prove actual-parent-entry dependency, exact same-market frozen-intent equality, no independent signal evaluation, no entry for every non-entered parent terminal path, separate accounting identity, diagnostics, and unchanged Paper/Live intent parity.

requirements.text: Start both counters once at zero without historical replay, preserve them across restarts, and leave all historical generation and runtime/database rollout for later explicit tasks.
requirements.sourceQuote: Запустим с нулём, а потом я попрошу тебя сгенерировать историю для обоих стратегий.
acceptanceCriteria: The ordered migration creates each durable state exactly once with value 0 and a database UTC cutoff; it neither reads nor imports pre-cutoff parent runs, and reapplying/skipping the migration cannot reset an existing state.
Ordinary processor/service restarts load and continue the persisted value; no startup hook scans all parent history or assigns a new cutoff.

The immutable 0001 baseline SQL and checksum remain byte/semantically unchanged; the new transactional migration is ordered after 0001 and has checksum-bound migration tests for fresh, already-applied, retry, rollback, and mismatch behavior.
No Local or Production migration is applied, no historical child record is generated, and no service is deployed/restarted by this implementation task.

verification.expected: Migration/catalog tests prove immutable baseline preservation, ordered transactional creation, exact zero/cutoff state, no history import, idempotent restart/apply behavior, rollback, and checksum mismatch rejection.

Only approved mapped implementation/documentation/context paths change, unrelated dirty work is preserved, formatting is clean, every requirement has passing evidence, and the completed contract validates.
